name: Aleem Siddique / The Compute Core — second edition

decisions.reason: Chosen after three documented studies. A layered object expresses connected hardware, AI and web work while semantic native-scroll chapters preserve clarity.
decisions.authority: User brief requests autonomous research, critique and selection; production remains on a review branch.

decisions.direction: Expressive colour / one continuous expanding core
decisions.reason: The user requested more colour, product-led storytelling inspired by Nothing, and a smooth local chip expansion instead of a travelling scene. Vermilion marks the four-project AMD collection and cobalt marks the playground.
decisions.authority: User-approved implementation plan; keep the existing review-before-deployment workflow.
